governance_mandate: Features without verified historical availability timestamps are strictly prohibited from model training

registry.provenance_dataset: Dataset A (Tehran Stock Exchange SME Panel)
registry.observation_timestamp_definition: Fiscal year-end date T_fy (e.g. December 31 / Esfand 29)
registry.availability_timestamp_definition: Public audited financial statement release timestamp T_pub (typically T_fy + 60 to 120 days)
registry.reporting_delay_days: 60 to 120 days (simulated as period index Time t)
registry.missing_data_treatment: Zero-fill for initial reporting period t=1; median-fill across sector x80 for irregular gaps
registry.leakage_risk_assessment: ZERO leakage; strictly backward-looking lag within Company group

registry.provenance_dataset: Dataset A (Tehran Stock Exchange SME Panel)
registry.availability_timestamp_definition: Public financial statement release timestamp T_pub
registry.missing_data_treatment: min_periods=1 allows computing mean on available historical periods

registry.provenance_dataset: Dataset A (Derived from Sector x80 and historical target)
registry.availability_timestamp_definition: Prior period realized distress rate: defaults_{x80, t-1} / active_firms_{x80, t-1}
registry.transformation_logic: Lagged sector default rate computed strictly on prior historical partitions
registry.missing_data_treatment: Global historical default rate fallback if sector has zero observations in prior period
registry.leakage_risk_assessment: PROTECTED via strict 1-period lag; never includes concurrent Time t target

registry.provenance_dataset: EXTERNAL_REQUIRED: Open Banking Bank Statement API
registry.observation_timestamp_definition: Real-time clearing timestamp of bank credit transactions
registry.availability_timestamp_definition: T_obs + 24 hours via daily end-of-day bank aggregator sync
registry.missing_data_treatment: Indicator flag for missing account connection; zero-fill velocity
registry.leakage_risk_assessment: Requires timestamp verification to prevent ingestion of post-prediction credit entries

registry.provenance_dataset: EXTERNAL_REQUIRED: Core Banking Exception Log / Clearinghouse Feed
registry.observation_timestamp_definition: Clearinghouse return timestamp (ACH / check return code)
registry.missing_data_treatment: Zero-fill (absence of return notification indicates normal payment processing)
registry.leakage_risk_assessment: Requires settlement timestamp isolation to prevent post-default return contamination

registry.provenance_dataset: EXTERNAL_REQUIRED: Commercial Credit Bureau (e.g. D&B PAYDEX / Experian)
registry.availability_timestamp_definition: Bureau monthly trade tape aggregation timestamp (T_due + 30 to 45 days)
registry.transformation_logic: max(days_past_due across all reported open trade lines)
registry.missing_data_treatment: Missing bureau coverage indicator flag + sector median imputation
registry.leakage_risk_assessment: Bureau tape publication date MUST precede prediction timestamp

registry.provenance_dataset: EXTERNAL_REQUIRED: Central Bank / FRED Macro Series
registry.observation_timestamp_definition: Monetary policy decision announcement date T_ann
registry.leakage_risk_assessment: ZERO leakage if announcement timestamp <= prediction timestamp

enforcement_rules: Rule 1: An observation timestamp (T_obs) alone is insufficient; an explicit availability timestamp (T_avail) must be recorded.
Rule 2: At prediction timestamp T_pred, a feature x is valid if and only if T_avail(x) <= T_pred.
Rule 3: Backward-looking windows must not include observations where T_obs > T_pred.
Rule 4: In absence of verified timestamp metadata (as in Dataset A), integer time step Time t serves as a proxy, and lag must be >= 1 for forward target t+1.
